body:
- I think _some_ duplication is warranted, as users may expect them there. In particular:
  - The "Save" option should probably stay on the context menu of specific files, because it is not unreasonable to want to save specific files outside of the one you have opened while not wanting to save everything per sé (eg. because autocomplete doesn't show a function you added elsewhere).
  - The "Close" and "Close All" options should probably stay in the "File" context menu. Those two options are to be expected there and to not pertain specifically to the files in the list.
  - I'm not 100% sure on only showing the "Run" and "Soft Reload Tool Script" options only in the file specific context menu. Both feel like options you'll want to run when you have the script open, and in that case having to go into the context menu for the specific file doesn't feel logical. I'd be conservative and have the options in both places.
- If we're doing a cleanup of duplicate options anyway, might as well remove the "History Previous" and "History Next" buttons from the "File" context menu. Those already have a dedicated button in the right top corner of the script button script, and its hover includes the shortcuts for them too.

Tried the PR again and I think the cleanup is ready for some wider usability testing which will make it clearer whether people miss the options in one place or the other. I can imagine that we might re-add some of the removed options if users come back with confusion, but it's hard to reason what makes the most sense here beforehand. Latest version: | Before | After | |--------|--------| | | | | | |
Yeah, lets get this integrated for feedback
